title.en: The Larmor formula and radiation from accelerated charges
title.et: Larmori valem ja kiirendatud laengute kiirgus

summary.en: Any accelerating charge radiates electromagnetic energy, at a total rate given by the Larmor formula: proportional to the square of the charge's acceleration, not its velocity. The formula follows from the retarded potentials — the recognition that a charge's field at a distant point reflects where and how it was moving at an earlier, light-travel-time-delayed moment, not where it is now.
summary.et: Iga kiirendatav laeng kiirgab elektromagnetilist energiat, kogumääraga, mille annab Larmori valem: võrdeline laengu kiirenduse ruuduga, mitte selle kiirusega. Valem tuleneb hilistunud potentsiaalidest — tõdemusest, et laengu väli kauges punktis peegeldab, kus ja kuidas see liikus varasemal, valguse levikuaja võrra hilistunud hetkel, mitte seda, kus see praegu on.
